body.purpose: SwiftUI .body for result titles; platform resolves size and metrics.

caption.purpose: SwiftUI .caption for source metadata, supporting text, and action hints.

code.purpose: NSFont.monospacedSystemFont for shared syntax-highlighted code previews.

shadows.name: palette
shadows.purpose: CSS preview approximation of SwiftUI shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.25), radius: 18, y: 6).

shadows.name: selected-card
shadows.purpose: CSS preview approximation of SwiftUI shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.28), radius: 9, y: 4); native selected scale is 1.04.

motion.name: card-entrance
motion.purpose: Native card entrance from opacity 0 and y 26; delay min(index, 8) * 0.028 seconds. Reduce Motion bypasses the entrance.

motion.name: card-selection
motion.purpose: Native selected-card lift and outline change.

motion.name: drawer-palette
motion.purpose: Native palette scale 0.95 plus opacity transition; shared glass disables animations under Reduce Motion.

native.units: Logical macOS points. Browser snippets use one CSS pixel per point for structural comparison; this is not a physical-unit conversion.
native.colorPolicy: Native dynamic color expressions are authoritative. No fixed palette or synthetic tonal ramp is defined. CSS Canvas, CanvasText, GrayText, and AccentColor in snippets are approximate browser counterparts, not replacement application tokens.

colors.name: supportingInk
colors.purpose: Breadcrumbs, source metadata, scope shortcuts, and caption-sized drawer action hints.

colors.name: subtleControlFill
colors.purpose: Source badges, saved searches, keyboard keycaps.

colors.name: opaquePanel
colors.purpose: Reduce Transparency fallback and the independent Actions menu surface.

materials.accessibility: AccessibleGlassPanel uses windowBackgroundColor for Reduce Transparency and clears animation transactions for Reduce Motion.

native.notCanonized: Demo content colors, source artwork colors, and screenshot-resolved native colors are content or environment outputs, not brand tokens. Unused legacy provider-header styling is not the current section-heading rule.

components.name: Launcher Query
components.description: A plain query field in the panel; the symbol and text are the focus. CSS system colors approximate the native semantic roles.
components.html: <label class="ds-query"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m15.5 15.5 5 5"/></svg><input aria-label="Search" placeholder="Search apps, files, clipboard, or the web…"/></label>

components.name: Launcher Scopes
components.description: Neutral active scope and quiet shortcut; the result selection below carries the accent.
components.css: .ds-scopes{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:0 12px 10px;background:Canvas;color-scheme:light dark}.ds-scopes button{border:0;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:CanvasText;font:500 12px system-ui}.ds-scopes button[aria-current]{background:color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 10%,transparent)}.ds-scopes small{margin-left:6px;color:GrayText;font:400 10px system-ui}.ds-scopes button:hover{color:CanvasText}.ds-scopes button:focus-visible{outline:auto;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Selected Result
components.description: Two-line result with system accent selection. Icon artwork remains native in the app; the snippet uses a neutral inline file symbol.

components.name: Footer Action
components.description: The selected primary action stays beside Return; secondary actions remain visibly available.
components.css: .ds-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:9px 20px;background:Canvas;color:GrayText;font:400 11px system-ui;color-scheme:light dark}.ds-footer-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.ds-footer button{padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:GrayText;font:inherit}.ds-footer button.ds-footer-primary{color:CanvasText;font-weight:500}.ds-footer button:hover{color:CanvasText}.ds-footer button:focus-visible{outline:auto;outline-offset:3px}.ds-footer i{height:12px;border-left:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 10%,transparent)}.ds-footer kbd{padding:1px 4px;border-radius:4px;background:color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 6%,transparent);font:400 10px system-ui}

components.name: Source Badge
components.description: A quiet informational capsule; this badge has no independent hover or action state.
components.html: App

components.name: Clipboard Card
components.description: Source header, content, and metadata in an outlined selected card. The native source-derived header tint is intentionally omitted from this content-neutral sample.

components.name: Action Palette
components.description: Shared native palette structure with query and selected action. Both the native menu and the HTML use an independent opaque surface to obscure the host content.
components.css: .ds-palette{width:380px;max-width:100%;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:Canvas;color:CanvasText;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 25%);font:400 13px system-ui;color-scheme:light dark}.ds-palette-query{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 10%,transparent);color:GrayText}.ds-palette-query input{min-width:0;flex:1;border:0;background:transparent;color:CanvasText;font:400 15px system-ui}.ds-palette-rows{display:grid;gap:2px;padding:6px}.ds-palette button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:CanvasText;font:inherit;text-align:left}.ds-palette button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:color-mix(in srgb,AccentColor 22%,transparent)}.ds-palette small{color:GrayText;font-size:11px}.ds-palette button:hover{color:CanvasText}.ds-palette button:focus-visible,.ds-palette input:focus-visible{outline:auto;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
Make the selected result recognizable and its action predictable. Overboard extends its existing macOS vocabulary: system type, native icons, restrained glass, and a single accent for selection. The interface is compact, calm, and useful at a glance. Content supplies the variety; the surrounding controls remain familiar.

Keep filenames, source apps, breadcrumbs, and the selected action legible before adding decoration. The launcher and clipboard drawer share materials and interaction cues while retaining the forms appropriate to searching and scanning recent copies. System appearance and accessibility preferences are part of the visual system.
keyCharacteristics: Native semantic colors and system typography.
One clear selection with a readable primary action.
Bounded lists, content-led previews, and compact metadata.
Restrained glass with an opaque accessibility fallback.
Source imagery and syntax color belong to content.

rules.name: The Selection Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the system accent to identify actionable selection; preserve primary and secondary text hierarchy inside the tint.

rules.name: The Native Color Rule
rules.body: Keep semantic color bindings live across appearance and accessibility changes. Do not turn screenshot pixel samples into application colors.

rules.name: The Recognition Rule
rules.body: Give the title the first reading position, then the source or path. Emphasize matched text with weight rather than adding another highlight color.

rules.name: The Reserved Footer Rule
rules.body: Keep the primary action and Actions affordance outside scrolling content, visible without covering the last result.

rules.name: The Accessible Material Rule
rules.body: Every shared glass surface must remain understandable with opaque backgrounds and without motion.

dos: **Do** use native semantic colors, system type, and meaningful platform icons.
**Do** preserve readable titles, breadcrumbs, source metadata, and action hints in both appearances.
**Do** keep a selected result and its primary action visually connected.
**Do** let previews and source imagery provide content-specific color.
**Do** verify glass, selection, and text with reduced transparency and reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** replace semantic native colors with fixed screenshot samples.
**Don't** use faint text to solve density or hierarchy problems for actionable hints.
**Don't** cover the last result or the primary footer action with an overlay.
**Don't** promote source artwork, demo content, or syntax colors into brand tokens.
**Don't** add decorative display typography or ornamental section labels to the compact command surface.
